title: BUILD-GV2-058-dormant-user-reactivation-triggers
universal_lens: Reactivation triggers form a state-transition kernel on user dormancy manifolds: a conformal predictor gates trigger emission via calibrated nonconformity scores, while a Bayesian updater fuses engagement priors with real-time edge signals to minimize false-positive reactivation cost under privacy-preserving rollback constraints.
gsi_mapping: GSI maps dormancy to a latent engagement posterior p(θ|H_t) updated via Bayesian filtering on sparse event streams; conformal prediction sets C_α(x) = {y: s(x,y) ≤ q_α} gate trigger eligibility where nonconformity s measures deviation from active-user embedding trajectories, ensuring finite-sample coverage 1-α.
gse_mapping: GSE implements a situational reasoning automaton: state S ∈ {DORMANT, CANDIDATE, TRIGGERED, REACTIVATED, SUPPRESSED} transitions via guard predicates G(s, x) = 1{τ_dormancy > T ∧ safety_check(x) ∧ ¬rollback_flag}; telemetry emits event-shape hashes for auditability and conformal calibration.

primitives.name: Dormancy Detection Operator
primitives.verbatim_quote: parent_id: BUILD-056 supersedes_id: none dependency_ids: none merge_notes: none ## Category retention / lifecycle ## Goal Build or specify dormant user reactivation triggers for Galaxy Sports Edge / GSN without changing production systems first.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: τ: dormancy window [days]; u: user ID; ϕ: engagement embedding ℝ^d; ε: activity threshold [dimensionless]; ∇_e: temporal gradient operator [day⁻¹]
primitives.assumptions: Engagement embeddings ϕ are Lipschitz-continuous; dormancy defined as sustained sub-threshold gradient norm; no production data access during specification phase.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Fails when embedding dimension d → ∞ (curse of dimensionality) or τ < minimum session interval (undersampling); singularity at ε = 0 (zero-activity trap).

layer2.mapping: Isomorphic to GSI conformal nonconformity score s(x,y) = ‖ϕ(x) - μ_active‖₂ where μ_active is active-user centroid; GSE state guard G_DORMANT = 𝒟_τ(u) ∧ ¬suppressed.
layer2.telemetry: Dormancy detection precision@k, false-dormant rate, embedding drift ‖∂_t ϕ‖_F

primitives.name: Reactivation Trigger Taxonomy
primitives.verbatim_quote: reason_not_duplicate: Winback exists; this defines product behavior and trigger taxonomy.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: c_i: trigger channel ∈ {email, homepage, push} [categorical]; π_i: trigger priority [dimensionless probability]; ρ_i: cooldown period [days]; N: taxonomy cardinality [count]
primitives.assumptions: Channels are mutually exclusive per user-session; priorities sum to ≤ 1; cooldowns enforce minimum inter-trigger interval; taxonomy extends BUILD-056 winback primitives.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Collapses when π_i → 0 ∀i (priority starvation) or ρ_i → 0 (trigger spam); channel conflict when |{c_i}| > 1 per session.

layer2.mapping: GSI: π_i = p(reactivate | c_i, H_t) from Bayesian posterior; GSE: trigger emission as state transition CANDIDATE → TRIGGERED with guard π_i > π_min ∧ t > last_trigger + ρ_i.
layer2.telemetry: Trigger conversion rate by channel, priority calibration error ‖π - π̂‖₁, cooldown violation count

primitives.name: Safety Validation Gate
primitives.verbatim_quote: Add tests or validation for event shape, copy safety, privacy, and rollback.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: ψ_k: k-th validator (event_shape, copy_safety, privacy, rollback) [boolean]; 𝒮_k: safe set for validator k [subset of output space]; ℋ: entropy of disclosed information [bits]; H_max: max disclosure entropy [bits]
primitives.assumptions: Validators are independent; safe sets 𝒮_k are convex; entropy bound enforces no method leakage; rollback flag is monotonic.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Validator collision when ∩𝒮_k = ∅ (over-constrained); entropy bound violation when H_max < min ℋ(x) (impossible disclosure); rollback deadlock when flag non-monotonic.

layer2.mapping: GSI: ℋ(x) ≤ H_max implements conformal disclosure control; GSE: 𝒱(x) = 1 enables TRIGGERED → REACTIVATED transition, else SUPPRESSED; telemetry logs validator pass/fail vector.
layer2.telemetry: Validator pass rates, entropy distribution ℋ(x), rollback invocation frequency, suppression rate

primitives.name: Approval Rollback Automaton
primitives.verbatim_quote: Stop before production data, public launch, live affiliate links, billing, or deploy.
primitives.latex: \mathcal{A} = (Q, \Sigma, \delta, q_0, F), \quad Q = \{SPEC, VALIDATED, APPROVED, DEPLOYED, ROLLED_BACK\}
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: Q: finite state set [categorical]; Σ: input alphabet {validate, approve, deploy, rollback, monitor} [categorical]; δ: transition function Q×Σ→Q [deterministic]; q_0 = SPEC; F = {ROLLED_BACK, DEPLOYED} [terminal states]
primitives.assumptions: Transitions require explicit human approval (no auto-deploy); rollback always reachable from any state; production data access only in DEPLOYED state; monitoring emits conformal calibration metrics.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Deadlock if approve without validate; irreversible if rollback transition removed; safety violation if DEPLOYED reached without APPROVED.

layer2.mapping: GSE: automaton governs build lifecycle state machine; GSI: conformal calibration monitors in DEPLOYED state feed back to SPEC via retraining trigger; telemetry emits state transition timestamps.
layer2.telemetry: State dwell times, transition success/failure rates, rollback latency, conformal coverage drift in DEPLOYED

The dormant reactivation system decomposes into four mathematically coupled operators. The dormancy detection operator 𝒟_τ defines a sublevel set on the engagement embedding gradient flow, inducing a Riemannian manifold where dormant users concentrate near zero-gradient regions. This is isomorphic to GSI's conformal nonconformity score: both measure deviation from an active reference distribution. The trigger taxonomy 𝒯 forms a marked point process on the product space of channels × priorities × cooldowns, where priorities π_i are Bayesian posterior reactivation probabilities calibrated via conformal prediction sets C_α. The safety gate 𝒱 implements a logical conjunction of validator predicates, equivalent to intersecting conformal safe sets 𝒮_k; its entropy bound ℋ(x) ≤ H_max enforces differential privacy on method disclosure. The approval automaton 𝒜 provides a deterministic finite-state controller ensuring no production transition without explicit approval, with rollback as a universal sink state. Dualities emerge: dormancy detection ↔ trigger emission (false dormant ↔ false trigger), safety validation ↔ approval gating (type I ↔ type II error control). Failure modes couple: embedding drift breaks 𝒟_τ, causing priority miscalibration in 𝒯, which floods 𝒱 with invalid events, triggering 𝒜 rollback. The system is stable iff the conformal coverage 1-α bounds the joint error rate across all four operators.
